authority: Draft diagnostic assessment for canonical Phase 1 admission; no benchmark result or status promotion.

source.object: P1-K0-23: y^2 + x*y = x^3 + 1 over GF(2^23), polynomial basis from the registered panel cell
source.subgroup: prime order r=2095853 generated by the exact P1-K0-23 panel generator; public targets follow ecbench hash_to_subgroup_v1

destination.object: C: v^2 + u^2*v = u^7 + u over the same GF(2^23)
destination.group_object: the order-r image of the source subgroup in Jac(C)(GF(2^23))

transformation.kind: degree-three pullback induced by phi(u,v)=(u^3,u*v+1), followed by an image-subgroup DLP solver and source scalar replay

nodes: order-r pullback image in the Jacobian
edges: generic rho/BSGS control or projected characteristic-two hyperelliptic relation collection
identity scalar recovery on the injective image
typed_path.weakest_open_obligation: run the preregistered 32-public-target Phase 1 comparison, retaining specialized-solver exhaustion as censored evidence and retaining replay receipts for every recovered target before assessing advantage

dimension.scope: source dimension one; destination curve genus three; DLP group is its dimension-three Jacobian

group_order.scope: the adapter uses the exact source prime r and solves only its pullback image

frobenius_or_weil_polynomial.scope: the explicit pullback certificate, not a Frobenius divisibility screen, supplies the route

field_of_definition.scope: source, cover, maps, and Jacobian arithmetic use the same registered polynomial-basis GF(2^23)

riemann_hurwitz_or_different.scope: the retained construction certificate checks genus three, degree three, separability, and ramification

polarization_or_jacobian_locus.scope: the destination is the Jacobian of the explicitly constructed smooth cover, not a product inferred from a polynomial

existence.scope: the ordinary binary degree-three cover family includes the exact a=0,b=1 Phase 1 source

explicit_construction.scope: native construction on the exact source field and model

map_correctness.scope: point-class pullback and degree-three composition witness on the implemented image

subgroup_preservation.scope: conditional on the exact registered source subgroup order, which the panel cell supplies

scalar_recovery.scope: the image solver returns the same scalar modulo r and ecbench replays it on the source

destination_solver_applicability.scope: generic rho and BSGS operate on the exact pullback image; the specialized candidate collects degree-one-place relations on the exact genus-3 cover, applies phi_* to each relation, and clears the exact source cofactor so every factor-base column has a logarithm in the unique order-r source subgroup

computational_advantage.scope: no canonical Phase 1 measurement has run

scaling_support.scope: toy and n=23 adapters exist, but the canonical phased scaling series is unmeasured

novelty_within_boundary.scope: this task integrates an existing route; it makes no novelty claim

solver_assessment.name: Phase 1 transfer-aware characteristic-two genus-3 index calculus
solver_assessment.implementation: jacobian_image.genus3_projected_ic_v1 in src/cryptanalysis/ecbench/methods.rs, using src/cryptanalysis/binary_hyperelliptic_index_calculus.rs; jacobian_image.rho3_v2 and jacobian_image.bsgs_v2 remain generic destination controls

applicability.scope: binary ordinary source, exact degree-three cover, order-r image subgroup

image_subgroup_access.scope: generator and target are pulled into the same image subgroup; arbitrary relation classes have an implemented pushforward back to the exact source curve

evidence: source group order 4*r with r prime
relation_or_search_compatibility.scope: for a relation a*phi^*G+b*phi^*Q=sum c_i F_i, pushforward and cofactor clearing give 12a*G+12b*Q=sum c_i*[4]phi_*F_i; every right-hand column lies in the unique order-r subgroup, so sparse elimination modulo r is sound

individual_log_and_recovery.scope: the target logarithm is a column of the sparse relation system, then verified in the destination and replayed on the source; budget exhaustion returns no candidate and is retained

unpriced_work: destination Jacobian operations, characteristic-two smoothness calls, and modular row operations have no certified source-GAE conversion

open_obligations: Run the preregistered 32-public-target five-arm spec under its required L2 isolation and retain specialized-solver exhaustion rather than substituting a generic solve.
Retain replay receipts and report wall-time comparisons separately from the still-unpriced source-GAE conversion for destination Jacobian operations.
